sections.body: Primary cards use Free CRM + Smart CRM/Customer Platform ladder from /products/crm (Starter $15*/seat/mo promo, Professional $50, Enterprise $75). Amounts are USD per seat per month as published; confirm live checkout for annual vs monthly commit on non-Enterprise tiers. Onboarding fees apply on some Professional/Enterprise hub purchases per catalog.
